question: Does the independently published pre-soft-s HMT/U(1) universal-matter construction provide a microscopic/UV action principle that uniquely fixes the surviving physical-metric matter-interface parameters before any RTK response comparison?

independent_sources.role: published source statement on UV action-principle origin, IR scalar-tensor emergence, and status of a1,a2

decision_rule: UNIQUE requires the audited pre-soft-s sources themselves to derive a unique physical-metric matter interface from a microscopic/UV action principle, including fixing all scalar-response-relevant coupling parameters. UNFIXED_FINE_TUNED_IR applies if the universal-coupling source explicitly states that its UV action-principle origin is not obvious, supplies only an IR scalar-tensor emergence with fine-tuning, and leaves a1,a2 arbitrary. INCOMPLETE applies if these source statements cannot be locked. This is scoped to the audited sources and is not a literature-wide impossibility theorem.
required_guards: sources predate current RTK soft-s obstruction
do not infer uniqueness from gauge invariance alone
do not choose a1 or a2 from RTK pole/residue/remainder
do not choose a1 or a2 from the observed soft-s obstruction
do not promote an IR fine-tuned emergence to a UV microscopic derivation
